verses.text: Praise the LORD! Oh give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; For His lovingkindness is everlasting.
verses.textZh: 你們要讚美耶和華！要稱謝耶和華，因他本為善；他的慈愛永遠長存！

verses.text: Who can speak of the mighty deeds of the LORD, Or can show forth all His praise?
verses.textZh: 誰能傳說耶和華的大能？誰能表明他一切的美德？

verses.text: How blessed are those who keep justice, Who practice righteousness at all times!
verses.textZh: 凡遵守公平﹔常行公義的，這人便為有福！

verses.text: Remember me, O LORD, in [Your] favor toward Your people; Visit me with Your salvation,
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，你用恩惠待你的百姓；求你也用這恩惠記念我，開你的救恩眷顧我，

verses.text: That I may see the prosperity of Your chosen ones, That I may rejoice in the gladness of Your nation, That I may glory with Your inheritance.
verses.textZh: 使我見你選民的福，樂你國民的樂，與你的產業一同誇耀。

verses.text: We have sinned like our fathers, We have committed iniquity, we have behaved wickedly.
verses.textZh: 我們與我們的祖宗一同犯罪；我們作了孽，行了惡。

verses.text: Our fathers in Egypt did not understand Your wonders; They did not remember Your abundant kindnesses, But rebelled by the sea, at the Red Sea.
verses.textZh: 我們的祖宗在埃及不明白你的奇事，不記念你豐盛的慈愛，反倒在紅海行了悖逆。

verses.text: Nevertheless He saved them for the sake of His name, That He might make His power known.
verses.textZh: 然而，他因自己的名拯救他們，為要彰顯他的大能，

verses.text: Thus He rebuked the Red Sea and it dried up, And He led them through the deeps, as through the wilderness.
verses.textZh: 並且斥責紅海，海便乾了；他帶領他們經過深處，如同經過曠野。

verses.text: So He saved them from the hand of the one who hated [them], And redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
verses.textZh: 他拯救他們脫離恨他們人的手，從仇敵手中救贖他們。

verses.text: The waters covered their adversaries; Not one of them was left.
verses.textZh: 水淹沒他們的敵人，沒有一個存留。

verses.text: Then they believed His words; They sang His praise.
verses.textZh: 那時，他們才信了他的話，歌唱讚美他。

verses.text: They quickly forgot His works; They did not wait for His counsel,
verses.textZh: 等不多時，他們就忘了他的作為，不仰望他的指教，

verses.text: But craved intensely in the wilderness, And tempted God in the desert.
verses.textZh: 反倒在曠野大起慾心，在荒地試探神。

verses.text: So He gave them their request, But sent a wasting disease among them.
verses.textZh: 他將他們所求的賜給他們，卻使他們的心靈軟弱。

verses.text: When they became envious of Moses in the camp, And of Aaron, the holy one of the LORD,
verses.textZh: 他們又在營中嫉妒摩西和耶和華的聖者亞倫。

verses.text: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, And engulfed the company of Abiram.
verses.textZh: 地裂開，吞下大坍，掩蓋亞比蘭一黨的人。

verses.text: And a fire blazed up in their company; The flame consumed the wicked.
verses.textZh: 有火在他們的黨中發起；有火燄燒燬了惡人。

verses.text: They made a calf in Horeb And worshiped a molten image.
verses.textZh: 他們在何烈山造了牛犢，叩拜鑄成的像。

verses.text: Thus they exchanged their glory For the image of an ox that eats grass.
verses.textZh: 如此將他們榮耀的主換為吃草之牛的像，

verses.text: They forgot God their Savior, Who had done great things in Egypt,
verses.textZh: 忘了神─他們的救主；他曾在埃及行大事，

verses.text: Wonders in the land of Ham [And] awesome things by the Red Sea.
verses.textZh: 在含地行奇事，在紅海行可畏的事。

verses.text: Therefore He said that He would destroy them, Had not Moses His chosen one stood in the breach before Him, To turn away His wrath from destroying [them].
verses.textZh: 所以，他說要滅絕他們；若非有他所揀選的摩西站在當中（原文是破口），使他的忿怒轉消，恐怕他就滅絕他們。

verses.text: Then they despised the pleasant land; They did not believe in His word,
verses.textZh: 他們又藐視那美地，不信他的話，

verses.text: But grumbled in their tents; They did not listen to the voice of the LORD.
verses.textZh: 在自己帳棚內發怨言，不聽耶和華的聲音。

verses.text: Therefore He swore to them That He would cast them down in the wilderness,
verses.textZh: 所以，他對他們起誓：必叫他們倒在曠野，

verses.text: And that He would cast their seed among the nations And scatter them in the lands.
verses.textZh: 叫他們的後裔倒在列國之中，分散在各地。

verses.text: They joined themselves also to Baal-peor, And ate sacrifices offered to the dead.
verses.textZh: 他們又與巴力•毗珥連合，且吃了祭死神（或譯：人）的物。

verses.text: Thus they provoked [Him] to anger with their deeds, And the plague broke out among them.
verses.textZh: 他們這樣行，惹耶和華發怒，便有瘟疫流行在他們中間。

verses.text: Then Phinehas stood up and interposed, And so the plague was stayed.
verses.textZh: 那時，非尼哈站起，刑罰惡人，瘟疫這才止息。

verses.text: And it was reckoned to him for righteousness, To all generations forever.
verses.textZh: 那就算為他的義，世世代代，直到永遠。

verses.text: They also provoked [Him] to wrath at the waters of Meribah, So that it went hard with Moses on their account;
verses.textZh: 他們在米利巴水又叫耶和華發怒，甚至摩西也受了虧損，

verses.text: Because they were rebellious against His Spirit, He spoke rashly with his lips.
verses.textZh: 是因他們惹動他的靈，摩西（原文是他）用嘴說了急躁的話。

verses.text: They did not destroy the peoples, As the LORD commanded them,
verses.textZh: 他們不照耶和華所吩咐的滅絕外邦人，

verses.text: But they mingled with the nations And learned their practices,
verses.textZh: 反與他們混雜相合，學習他們的行為，

verses.text: And served their idols, Which became a snare to them.
verses.textZh: 事奉他們的偶像，這就成了自己的網羅，

verses.text: They even sacrificed their sons and their daughters to the demons,
verses.textZh: 把自己的兒女祭祀鬼魔，

verses.text: And shed innocent blood, The blood of their sons and their daughters, Whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan; And the land was polluted with the blood.
verses.textZh: 流無辜人的血，就是自己兒女的血，把他們祭祀迦南的偶像，那地就被血污穢了。

verses.text: Thus they became unclean in their practices, And played the harlot in their deeds.
verses.textZh: 這樣，他們被自己所做的污穢了，在行為上犯了邪淫。

verses.text: Therefore the anger of the LORD was kindled against His people And He abhorred His inheritance.
verses.textZh: 所以，耶和華的怒氣向他的百姓發作，憎惡他的產業，

verses.text: Then He gave them into the hand of the nations, And those who hated them ruled over them.
verses.textZh: 將他們交在外邦人的手裡；恨他們的人就轄制他們。

verses.text: Their enemies also oppressed them, And they were subdued under their power.
verses.textZh: 他們的仇敵也欺壓他們，他們就伏在敵人手下。

verses.text: Many times He would deliver them; They, however, were rebellious in their counsel, And [so] sank down in their iniquity.
verses.textZh: 他屢次搭救他們，他們卻設謀背逆，因自己的罪孽降為卑下。

verses.text: Nevertheless He looked upon their distress When He heard their cry;
verses.textZh: 然而，他聽見他們哀告的時候，就眷顧他們的急難，

verses.text: And He remembered His covenant for their sake, And relented according to the greatness of His lovingkindness.
verses.textZh: 為他們記念他的約，照他豐盛的慈愛後悔。

verses.text: He also made them [objects] of compassion In the presence of all their captors.
verses.textZh: 他也使他們在凡擄掠他們的人面前蒙憐恤。

verses.text: Save us, O LORD our God, And gather us from among the nations, To give thanks to Your holy name And glory in Your praise.
verses.textZh: 耶和華─我們的神啊，求你拯救我們，從外邦中招聚我們，我們好稱讚你的聖名，以讚美你為誇勝。

verses.text: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, From everlasting even to everlasting. And let all the people say, 'Amen.' Praise the LORD!
verses.textZh: 耶和華─以色列的神是應當稱頌的，從亙古直到永遠。願眾民都說：阿們！你們要讚美耶和華！
